statement: The manual norepinephrine rate-control semantics -- start, increase, decrease, stop and restart by an explicit absolute rate in mcg/min -- are ratified for DEVELOPMENT (status NOREPINEPHRINE_MANUAL_RATE_CONTROL_DEVELOPMENT_SEMANTICS_CLOSED; the human review is reported, not verified against the persisted store). The inherited defect by which 'titrate norepinephrine to MAP 65' was executed as 65 mcg/min was reproduced end to end, traced to two layers (the frozen reader fabricated the rate from the only number of the clause; the frozen engine completion made it executable by inheriting the running infusion's units) and repaired before the engine, in the order pipeline, which is not frozen: an infusion order that carries a rate WITHOUT units is held as a question, nothing is executed and the held copy keeps no number. The rule is structural -- no list of words -- so a MAP, a PA, a heart rate or a typo are the same thing. The reader, the completion and the engine were NOT touched (a first design that did was defeated by the independent review and broke two freezes; it was reverted). The only executable changes are the pipeline rule and the Spanish text of its message. The shadow keeps consuming the order as written (verdict A of the boundary audit); malformed-order recovery was analysed and not changed. Nitroglycerin, which carries its unit in the field name, is NOT covered (a residual that predates the cycle).

why_not_the_others.B: the boundary audit returned A (raw order remains the correct boundary): nothing about the safe boundary is unresolved
why_not_the_others.C: the repair is one structural rule in the order pipeline, after the reader and before the engine, for the infusion orders that complete a missing unit (norepinephrine, dobutamine, epinephrine and the role-named order); the generic parser was NOT changed (it is frozen), no other family of orders changed, and the other interpreter findings (the verb 'restart', a relative command without a rate, nitroglycerin) were NOT changed; a source-level repair would need the reader freeze lifted, which is a faculty decision, not a blocker of this fix
why_not_the_others.D: the raw-versus-resolved choice is not genuinely open for this stage: the raw boundary is the safest, the only one compatible with everything certified, and every divergence measured is a declared fidelity gap, not a safety defect; moving toward resolved orders WOULD be a faculty decision and none was made
why_not_the_others.E: no malformed-order behavior creates a demonstrated safety defect: the shadow has no authority over norepinephrine, is invisible to the resident and declares every divergence; recovery was analysed and is a separate faculty decision (FD-NR-07)
why_not_the_others.F: the order model needed no redesign: one structural rule in the pipeline repaired the defect and every other layer behaved as designed
